title: Latency and timeouts on storage-svc

detection.alert: storage-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on storage-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] storage-svc 2026-07-16 18:41-22:21: storage-svc: 293 of 389 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-16 18:41 and 2026-07-16 22:21 UTC (peak error ratio 0.94 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: Slow BlockReceiver write data to disk <*> (threshold=300ms)

_templates.macro: Terraform change to the storage-svc datanode EBS volume cut gp3 throughput and IOPS; the extra replica writes after dfs.replication was raised then saturated the volume.
_templates.remediation: Restore throughput/IOPS on {resource} (terraform {version_from}); alarm on EBS VolumeQueueLength and BurstBalance.

culprit.diff:
@@ -48,3 +48,3 @@ aws_ebs_volume.storage_svc_data
 resource "aws_ebs_volume" "storage_svc_data" {
-  throughput = 250
+  throughput = 125
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change to the storage-svc datanode EBS volume cut gp3 throughput and IOPS; the extra replica writes after dfs.replication was raised then saturated the volume.
rca.remediation: Restore throughput/IOPS on aws_ebs_volume.storage_svc_data (terraform tf-r10); alarm on EBS VolumeQueueLength and BurstBalance.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `<*> exception while serving <*> to <*>`.
